name: Spectral Tracking
definition: A spectral volume rendering technique that handles per-wavelength optical properties by decomposing the medium's scattering and absorption coefficients into spectral components, using a majorant density to drive the sampling process.
summary: Spectral Tracking is a volumetric rendering technique that efficiently handles spectrally resolved optical properties by using a single majorant density to drive sampling for all wavelengths simultaneously, unlike naive delta tracking which invokes the tracker separately for each wavelength.
